description: The painted shape of a focus ring is determined by the focused element's own border box, its own `border-radius`, the offset/width pair, and every clip between that box and the screen — not by the component's visual appearance. Use when adding or reviewing `:focus-visible` styles on buttons, cards, rows, links, or list items, and especially when a focus ring looks wrong: corners cut off, ring broken into four straight segments, ring missing on one side, ring completely invisible, ring larger than the visible control, or a wrapped link's ring appearing as two separate rectangles.
